notes: The recursive self-interrupting syntax, the em-dash bracketing, and the move from phenomenology to product feature to quiet philosophical claim are all convincingly Wallacean, though the piece skews more toward his essayistic register than his fiction and lacks the footnote-driven anxiety and self-undermining irony that would make it truly uncanny; usability suffers because the copy is too long and too cerebral for most product contexts, though a premium brand with the right audience could absolutely run it.
